title: A universe with no name yet
summary: An empty world: the first request you send becomes its first law, and the story follows from it without exception.
request:
A new world, with nothing fixed yet: this first request becomes its first law.

Say what exists here and what it costs: what sustains life, who holds power, what cannot be done,
and what is true from the first page. One world, one central question, a few characters.

You can replace every line above with your own.
